annotations.title: Link files of the same sample

description: Groups files that measured the same sample across instruments and formats (sample id, barcode, plate well + plate, a conversion naming its source, the same acquisition or the same spectra), from headers; every link has its evidence and a confidence (high/medium/low; links below min_confidence are listed in weak_links).

from_index.description: Also take the data sets an index query selects: the index directory …

min_confidence.description: `low`, `medium` (default) or `high`: weaker links are listed in weak_links, not grouped.

no_recursive.description: Only the top level of directories.

paths.description: Directories (walked recursively), files or glob patterns.

name: openreadout_link

oneOf.description: Circumstantial: a shared control name, a short id inside a file name.
Likely: the same sample name or file stem, a start time without a run length.

Recorded identifiers agree (barcode, sample id, the conversion's source file, the same
acquisition).

detail.description: The values compared, and where they came from.

InputReport.description: How the inputs turned into data sets.

datasets.description: Data sets measured (rows come from these), including those that failed.

failed.description: Data sets that failed (their rows carry `error`).

grouped_members.description: Files that belong to another input's multi-file data set (measured once, with it).

reused.description: Data sets whose rows were reused from the journal of an interrupted run.

skipped_examples.description: A few of the skipped paths, with why.

skipped_format.description: Data sets of other formats left out by the format filter.

skipped_sheets.description: Sample sheets and layouts found among the inputs (never measured).

skipped_unknown.description: Files found by walking a directory that no reader recognises (not in the table).

Link.description: A link between two data sets.

LinkGroup.description: Data sets that measured the same sample.

confidence.description: The weakest link that holds the group together (low when the group has a conflict).

conflicts.description: Disagreements inside the group (different sample ids).

group.description: Group number (from 1, in the order of the first member).

sample.description: The sample id the members share, when they do.

SharedIdentifier.description: An identifier shared by many data sets or naming a control.

reason.description: Why it was treated as weak.

groups.description: Groups of two or more data sets.

inputs.description: How the inputs became data sets.

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence of links that form groups.
